title: Wings of Blue and tankers perform for the Frontiers in Flight airshow
description: The U.S. Air Force Academy Wings of Blue Parachute Demonstration Team, a KC-135 Stratotanker and KC-46A Pegasus perform during the Frontiers in Flight Air Show and Open House at McConnell Air Force Base, Kansas, Oct. 24, 2026. McConnell hosts the air show every two years, opening the base for a free, two-day event allowing the public to see firsthand and up close how the Air Force operates. Through these events, the base continues to build meaningful connections with the greater Wichita community and beyond while strengthening public engagement, building mutual understanding, and highlighting the installation’s commitment to the region it serves. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Patrick O’Neill)
